reconciliation.transport: M536 timeout-aware runner wrote a bounded receipt after 30 seconds plus 5 seconds grace and observed child termination; transport timeout is not app success.
reconciliation.appTrace: The isolated v2 route reached fixture PASS, BACKGROUND_ASSET_ROLE_MISMATCH inspection BLOCKED, preview, session-preflight MISSING, ownership-gated previewed transition, and stopped before approval/apply/reread/commit.
reconciliation.rootCause: The route stores lifecycle stage in a ref. The previewed branch updates that ref and invokes recordProjectUiSelfTestProgress, but that function only performs native receipt I/O and does not cause a React state update. The effect therefore has no guaranteed wake-up to run its previewed-to-approving branch.
reconciliation.outcomeDisposition: Post-preview approval/session persistence and later lifecycle remain outcome-unknown at the timeout boundary; no browser-storage inspection or terminalization is authorized.
reconciliation.selectedCorrection: Add one dedicated typed React state wake-up for the broken-reference self-test after the previewed progress receipt completes, include it in the effect dependencies, and retain the exact previewed/ownership/session checks before approval. Guard the wake-up so it cannot duplicate approval or cross the closed test namespace.

recapture or retry the timed-out executable

infer approval, apply, reread, commit, or Stage 11 acceptance from the partial trace

notes: M537 is a read-only diagnosis and boundary selection. It does not certify the packaged lifecycle, approval, apply, reread, commit, Stage 11, Foundry authority, or Ready-to-Play.
